text:
mira: Heads-up: Seaforth private VPC onboarding dry-run scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow. Quick triage now: VPC peering, NAT capacity, KMS CMK grants, CloudTrail sink and retention ask (they want 5y). tagging @ash @tom @priya :eyes:

ash: I'll scan peering and route tables. Prioritize prod, analytics, and redis-cache subnets.

tom: I'll check CloudTrail -> S3 config and bucket encryption. Note: procurement asked for SSE-KMS + retention policy to 5 years.

priya: KMS checklist: verify key state, rotation, admin principals, and cloudtrail principal. Also confirm creation date for compliance doc.

nash: Found peering pcx-0b2c3d4e between seaforth-prod and analytics. Missing route in analytics-rtb; adding route now. Command used: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0b1c2d3 --destination-cidr-block 10.30.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0b2c3d4e`

ops-bot: infra-bot: Route create event recorded (chg-0c3d4e5f) at 2026-03-23T14:12:11Z by nash

tom: CloudTrail exists (seaforth-audit), bucket seaforth-audit-us-west-2. Bucket default encryption is AES256; not using KMS. I'll add migration plan: create CMK alias/enable CloudTrail->KMS and re-encrypt objects.

priya: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:888899990000:key/ccbb-a1b2 created 2025-02-10. Policy missing cloudtrail service principal and lacks explicit redwood-audit role grant. Sample statement to add: `{"Sid":"AllowCloudTrail","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}`

mira: Renewal note: they requested HSM-backed keys and longer retention. Marking renewal risk as "medium" until solutions provides cost delta and timeline. @tom please add retention impact to SOW draft.

ash: Security groups: found sg-0a7b8c9 allowing 0.0.0.0/0 egress on app-tier ephemeral ports. Tightening to known ranges and will upload SG export.

ops-bot: compliance-bot: KMS policy PR #4012 opened by priya (adds CloudTrail principal + audit role).

mira: Thanks team. Please drop the SG/NAT/route gist links here so CS can attach to the ticket and I'll update the onboarding runbook. Closing this sync.
